content: Bhaja Govindam, Bhaja Govindam, Govindam Bhaja Mudhamate! (Seek the Divine, seek the Divine, O fool! When the appointed hour arrives, grammatical rules will not save you).
author: Adi Shankara
explanation: Shankara cautions against sterile intellectualizing and academic pedantry that neglects practical spiritual awakening and heartfelt devotion.
practicalInsight: Notice if you are collecting theoretical ideas without applying them. Put one vital spiritual or ethical principle into concrete action today.
reflectionPrompt: Am I using spiritual intellectualism to hide from the vulnerable work of inner surrender and presence?
